southeast.title: A painful homecoming: Faulder residents return to see what the Bald range fire left behind

southeast.title: 3rd grizzly in family of 4 killed in B.C.'s West Kootenay
southeast.description: A third grizzly in a family of four well-known bears in the West Kootenay has been killed.

all.title: Wildland firefighters warned not to take supplements for smoke or PFAS exposure
all.description: A drug marketed to wildland firefighters exposed to smoke or PFAS shows no evidence of being effective, leading the International Association of Firefighters and the Food and Drug Administration to warn against its use. The drug, called glutathione, is marketed to fire fighters to remove toxins, but the IAFF says there are no scientific studies […]

all.title: Studying combined fuel treatments gives us a better picture of effectiveness
all.description: While many studies have established that fuel treatments are an effective wildfire mitigation tool, the gap in our understanding has been how a range of different treatments work together over many years across large areas to produce a desired outcome. all.title: Another MLA leaves BC Conservative Party as Bruce Banman announces exit
all.description: 'The goal in politics is to make the tent bigger. To listen to the majority. It’s not about left or right. It’s about doing what’s right,' Bruce Banman said in a statement.
